sources.title: Silver Creek Point Fire Lookout Cabin

notes_for_editor: Build year 1936 and the 2017 NHLR registration agree across all four sources. Access is not stated on any page read; Idaho Fire Lookouts says drive-up, and the story asks readers to check with the Forest Service. Staffing is dated (NHLR description at 2017, staff list 1965 and approximate 2019). The brief's height_m 7.3 matches the 24-foot base and is proposed for removal. Not read: the Idaho climbing guide page for Silver Creek (idahoaclimbingguide.com), which may describe access and location; it was not read because this tower hit its page budget.
